title: A great day at Montserrat.
text:
We really enjoyed our day at Montserrat.  We bought the tickets here and the experience was smooth and easy. They were communicative about the time to see the Black Madonna and we received our tickets very quickly after booking.  I was impressed and happy with the whole experience from start to finish.  
It was a fun day doing something outside of the city.
author: kara_l

title: Learning more about Spanish Culture
text: My parents, my wife, my three early 20’s daughters and a friend of theirs loved this.  We will be able to keep the memories of our trip alive by learning to cook some of the dishes we had on our visit.  100% would recommend as a MUST do on your visit.
author: Chris_P
